candidates.description: This vector activates on short character sequences, prefixes, and multilingual subwords starting with the letters 'm', 'a', or 'h'.
This vector represents common Thai linguistic sub-word tokens and prefixes, often associated with the verb 'to be' (เป็น) or similar structural particles, mixed with English article fragments.
This vector represents Thai language characters, diacritics, and phonemes.
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter "ต" (to tao) appearing as a subword or character component across various Thai words.
This vector represents the set of consonant characters in the Thai alphabet.
These tokens represent Thai vowel signs and tonal diacritics combined with consonant clusters.
This vector represents common suffixes, syllables, and grammatical endings frequently found in Romance languages and proper nouns.
This vector activates on capitalized and lowercase word-initial consonant clusters and bigrams.
This vector activates for tokens containing the letters "k" and "kk" across various scripts and romanizations.
This feature vector activates on subwords, characters, and fragments related to Thai script and romanized lexical roots.
